sources.name: Amtsgericht Charlottenburg – Amtsgerichtsplatz 1
sources.note: 1895–97 courthouse and stylistically continuous 1915–21 extension; yellow Silesian sandstone, courtyard, Baroque portal. Full measured original roof and walls replace only their audited flattened owner.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Charlottenburg – Hardenbergstraße 31
sources.note: Current commercial register within the shared Hardenbergstraße 31 court building; only a restrained service sign is added, not a relabelling of all OVG premises.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Wedding – Brunnenplatz 1
sources.note: 1901–06 late-Gothic courthouse, projecting central mass, short wings and sculpted portal. All 12 original LoD2 parts, gables and roof surfaces replace the exact old 15 m core prism. Portal relief proportions and pane subdivisions are estimated.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Wedding – Schönstedtstraße 5
sources.note: Separate active Mahngericht at Schönstedtstraße 5. The retained OSM parcel address says Brunnenplatz 1; the current official service address takes precedence for identity, with no geometry relocation.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Köpenick – Mandrellaplatz 6
sources.note: Main courthouse at Mandrellaplatz 6; mapped footprint is exact, fallback 14.3 m height is unsurveyed. No guessed tower or invented roof.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Köpenick – Mandrellaplatz 6 – Grundbuchgebäude
sources.note: Separately mapped Grundbuch building within the same official Mandrellaplatz 6 court site; no separate postal entrance is claimed. Height remains an unsurveyed source fallback.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Kreuzberg – Möckernstraße 130
sources.note: Current name is Amtsgericht Kreuzberg, rather than the previous Tempelhof-Kreuzberg name; historic Möckernstraße main building retained.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Kreuzberg – Hallesches Ufer 62
sources.note: Current separate family-court service at Hallesches Ufer 62; restrained modern portal and lintels, original footprint/height retained.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Lichtenberg – Roedeliusplatz 1
sources.note: Neo-Renaissance 1906 courthouse, triangular plan; complete measured official wall/roof source added where no delivered body existed.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Lichtenberg – Westhafenstraße 1 – Zollspeicher
sources.note: Current Grundbucharchiv is in the Westhafen Zollspeicher, not the neighbouring grain silo. Brick warehouse footprint and existing height retained.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Mitte – Littenstraße 12–17
sources.note: Littenstraße 12–17. Existing complete v183 palace, halls and source roof are protected; only the restrained entrance recognition is additive.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Neukölln – Karl-Marx-Straße 77–79
sources.note: 1899–1901 Neo-Renaissance building at Karl-Marx-Straße 77/79; existing body kept with corner masonry and a shallow arched portal cue.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Pankow – Parkstraße 71
sources.note: Current name Amtsgericht Pankow; principal building Parkstraße 71 in Weißensee remains distinct from its family court. Existing estimated source height remains unchanged.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Pankow – Kissingenstraße 5–6
sources.note: Current family-court branch at Kissingenstraße 5–6. Exact mapped independent building retained, not moved to the main Parkstraße address.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Schöneberg – Grunewaldstraße 66–67
sources.note: Rusticated sandstone base and decorated Baroque entrance; tall original body and all source roof edges remain.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Schöneberg – Ringstraße 9
sources.note: Ringstraße 9 is an active Lichterfelde branch of Amtsgericht Schöneberg, not merely a former court. Existing mapped body remains unchanged.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Spandau – Altstädter Ring 7
sources.note: Current 1954 courthouse at Altstädter Ring 7; deliberately plain modern framing, no fictitious historic clocktower.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Tiergarten – Kirchstraße 6 – gemeinsamer Gerichtskomplex
sources.note: Kirchstraße 6 is a current separate AG Tiergarten service within a shared court complex. A bounded service sign does not relabel the whole Verwaltungsgericht.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Tiergarten – Tempelhofer Damm 12 – Bereitschaftsgericht
sources.note: Current criminal standby court at Tempelhofer Damm 12 shares the large police building. Only its bounded service cue is added; the police campus is not reconstructed or renamed.

sources.name: Landgericht Berlin II – Tegeler Weg 21 – Erweiterungsbau
sources.note: The 1987 north annex at Tegeler Weg belongs to Landgericht Berlin II, not Amtsgericht Charlottenburg. It is explicitly separated in identity and geometry; the v183 old Landgericht remains untouched.

sources.name: Amtsgericht Tiergarten – Kriminalgericht Moabit
sources.note: Current Turmstraße/Wilsnacker Straße/Alt-Moabit complex; existing v166/v183 complete model and its differentiated towers are retained, not rebuilt.
